moments.title: Content is the next code
moments.insight: Matt argues enterprises are now turning to AI for content the way they did for coding, but the guardrails are still missing.

moments.title: LLMs turned writers into editors
moments.insight: A client fired all writers, then found her remaining team spends 80% of time fixing LLM-generated content instead of writing.

moments.title: Scanning 5 million pages after an acquisition
moments.insight: Markup AI can scan millions of pages to flag or auto-fix brand inconsistencies after a company acquisition.

moments.title: Bring healthy skepticism to all content
moments.insight: Matt says AI makes it more critical than ever to teach people—especially kids—to spot credibility signals, since teens can spot fakes better than adults.
